limitations_and_boundaries: Requires either known noise entropies or weakly monotonically increasing noise entropies along directed paths.
Additionally requires one of: mild extension of faithfulness, strictly monotonically increasing noise entropies, or expanded noise injectivity.
No assumption on graph topology (e.g., sparsity), functional form (e.g., linearity), or noise distribution.
Algorithms access data only via a conditional entropy oracle.
Theoretical results; no empirical validation provided.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

experiments_or_tasks: Implement repeated source removal (SOUR) and repeated sink removal (SIR) using conditional entropy oracle to identify sources/sinks.

methods.name: SOUR algorithm (causal discovery)
methods.protocol_description: Iteratively remove sources by selecting variables with conditional entropy equal to noise entropy (if known) or minimal conditional entropy (if noise entropies are weakly monotonically increasing).

methods.name: SIR algorithm (causal discovery)
methods.protocol_description: Iteratively remove sinks by selecting variables with conditional entropy equal to noise entropy (if known) or maximal conditional entropy (if noise entropies are weakly monotonically increasing or under extended injectivity).
